name: Libbet
author: Damian Yerrick (game); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Libbet and the Magic Floor, a Game Boy puzzle game by Damian Yerrick: roll Libbet across the basement and flip every tile of the magic floor. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator (Peanut-GB) with sound, touch controls and gamepads. zlib license (github.com/pinobatch/libbet).

descriptions.en: Libbet and the Magic Floor, a Game Boy puzzle game by Damian Yerrick: roll Libbet across the basement and flip every tile of the magic floor. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator (Peanut-GB) with sound, touch controls and gamepads. zlib license (github.com/pinobatch/libbet).
descriptions.it: Libbet and the Magic Floor, rompicapo per Game Boy di Damian Yerrick: fai rotolare Libbet nella cantina e gira tutte le piastrelle del pavimento magico (testi in inglese). Gira sull'emulatore Game Boy integrato (Peanut-GB) con audio, comandi touch e gamepad. Licenza zlib (github.com/pinobatch/libbet).
